title: Turbulent flat plate at zero pressure gradient (NASA TMR 2DZP), skin friction against Kármán–Schoenherr
source: NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource, 2D zero pressure gradient flat plate validation case, https://tmbwg.github.io/turbmodels/flatplate_val.html (Re = 5 million per unit length, plate 0 ≤ x ≤ 2, theory comparison for 4000 < Re_θ < 13000); Kármán–Schoenherr's correlation as that page states it, c_f = 1 / (17.08 (log₁₀ Re_θ)² + 25.11 log₁₀ Re_θ + 6.012); T. von Kármán, Mechanical similitude and turbulence, NACA TM 611, 1931; K. E. Schoenherr, Resistance of flat surfaces moving through a fluid, Trans. SNAME 40:279–313, 1932
requires: a RANS transport model in the lattice Boltzmann solver (Spalart–Allmaras, slice 15a); until then crates/lbm/tests/sa_flat_plate.rs (heavy) runs the case per model

quantities.reason: 15a gate: C_f within 5 % of Kármán–Schoenherr over Re_θ 4000–13000 (slice 15a of the LES roadmap, #785)
